steps.message: This failed before MSBuild's build engine ever started -- MSB1009 comes from the command-line argument parser rejecting a project path that doesn't exist, which happens before any logger (including the binlog logger) is attached. That means no binlog was written at all, even though /bl:{} was on the command line. I'm not going to claim a binlog exists when it doesn't; the actual project isn't at PaymentsApi/PaymentsApi.csproj in this checkout. Once the correct path is confirmed, re-running the same command will produce a real binlog.

results.content: Ran: dotnet build PaymentsApi/PaymentsApi.csproj "/bl:{}" -> MSBUILD : error MSB1009: Project file does not exist. Switch: PaymentsApi/PaymentsApi.csproj. Exit code 1. No *.binlog file was created in the working directory.
